tool_args.rationale: The previous model call failed before fresh confirmation because its predictor referenced an undefined training variable. This corrected implementation fits both static linear coefficients numerically and predicts from stored fitted parameters. Eight observations at the target horizon have y/u_now ratios clustered around 1.97 despite variation in other supplied features, supporting a static linear candidate; fresh confirmation is still needed to establish the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All eight paid observations share the target H=3.6 and closely track a simple linear dependence on u_now; there is no observed time dependence motivating the additional wait and reset cost.
The near-proportional response does not indicate a branch ambiguity, so an extra measurement is not justified.
